evidence.title: HTML-in-Canvas コンポーネントライブラリ Canvas UI

name: HTML-in-Canvas コンポーネントライブラリ Canvas UI
summary: Article walking through Canvas UI, a component library that runs WebGL effects over real HTML via the HTML-in-Canvas API.
description: A Japanese blog post introducing Canvas UI: React, Solid, Vue and Svelte components that apply WebGL effects to real DOM content with the experimental HTML-in-Canvas API, distributed as shadcn registry items. It shows Droplets, HexFloat, Glass and Shatter in use and explains the fallback for browsers without the API.
contains: walkthrough of Canvas UI components: Droplets, HexFloat, Glass, Shatter
React, Solid, Vue and Svelte support; shadcn registry install (npx shadcn@latest add @canvas-ui/<name>)
WebGL effects over real HTML while keeping DOM interactivity and accessibility
fallback to plain HTML or a WebGL overlay in browsers without the API
